about: Ask to exempt one vehicle from Darb tolls.
note: Requirements read from the official Abu Dhabi Mobility page on the checked date. This service has no sign-in form of its own to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: On request, one vehicle per category for people of determination, low income families, senior citizens and retired citizens
Ambulances, civil defence, police, taxis, school buses, public buses, motorcycles and trailers are exempt without a request
